scope: Assistant work requested before user-launched full validation: read/synthesize papers, implement, run small online experiments, analyze and improve, and hand off a reviewable full-validation command. No claim of paper acceptance or completed full evaluation.

requirements.requirement: Ground candidate choices in the seven uploaded papers and existing SPORK literature
Keep SPORK as a concrete reproduced reference and implement a new combination
requirements.details: Both parent and child use full Target reasoning; speculative tool observations enable early child computation; reuse requires exact compatibility.

requirements.requirement: Run and analyze live small GPU experiments, including failures and slowdowns
requirements.details: Six training tasks in two-turn tests, three training tasks in up-to-eight-turn tests, and two training tasks repeated in both orders with cache reset. The sets overlap and are not independent held-out samples.

requirements.requirement: Obtain a material speed benefit while checking behavior
requirements.details: Controlled repeated comparison: 128.9053 -> 109.0630 s mean, 15.393% reduction; all Actor tokens, actions/results/state equal. Exploratory multi-turn comparison: 6.871% reduction with equal trajectories and replies. Slowdowns retained.

requirements.requirement: Iterate code based on evidence rather than only propose ideas
requirements.details: Dropped extra confirmation from default; implemented multi-turn composition; repaired stale HTTP connection handling; added per-trial cache reset and opposite-order repeats.

requirements.requirement: Prepare source/configuration, commands and integrity checks for user full validation
Keep GPU work in user-specified tmux sessions
requirements.details: Model service used vllm:codex-research; every GPU experiment used a train window. CPU-only checks did not request model inference.

limitations: This establishes a usable research candidate and smoke result, not a top-conference contribution by itself.
Current full-validation runner is the fixed-user-message SPORK harness; its ACTION score is not official interactive tau2 success.
Serving/input compatibility and isolated benchmark state are required. No universal losslessness claim for arbitrary external tools or nondeterministic backends.

Canonical state-changing child commits have CPU contract coverage; the observed fresh multi-turn samples mostly ended at user-confirmation replies. Broader real-task coverage is a purpose of full validation.
